consolidation_rationale: Six facets on the same theme (T1, intent-semantics axis) converge on one module: a typed reconciliation object (primary, T1-F2-4) needs an intent-to-recipe registry to know which merge protocol applies (T1-F4-3), a third divergence intent to slot into that registry (T1-F3-2), a recapture path for chaperone-rejected offloads so rejection notes aren't silently lost from the same reconciliation surface (T1-F1-4), a cap-bounded panel-fan-out reconciliation shape for the moonshot advisory-jury facet (T1-F6-6), and a durable ledger closing the loop back to /retro (T1-F4-4). Building these as one capability avoids three separate PRs each re-deriving the same merge-protocol dispatch point.

executor_profile.justification: Mechanical-but-hazardous: a new typed schema, registry lookup, and cap-bounded fan-out path layered onto an already-shipped chaperone-dispatch contract. Sonnet is correct tier per fleet tiering guidance (mechanical/deterministic, not judgment-heavy design). High effort because the work spans two plugins (saga, team-execution), touches the gate-adjacent engine_dispatch.satisfy_gate path where a regression would silently weaken {#external-engines-never-gatekeepers}, and needs careful registry-parity and cap-boundary test coverage. team-execution backend recommended over inline because the six absorbed facets are independently testable units well suited to reviewer-consensus and validator-gated execution, and the gate-adjacent path benefits from the read-only-verifier review posture this repo already mandates for verify-class spawns. Effort is target posture: not a live team-execution dispatch knob until pf-effort-first-class lands; teammates inherit session tier until then.
